name: Secrets
description: Read, write and list the workspace's secrets, where reading goes through a human approval on Telegram — unless that secret's gate has been turned off in Settings. Backed by aw-vault via aw-backend's /api/approval/* — this app stores nothing itself. NOT the same as an app's own config secrets (`ctx.secrets`, capability `secrets:own`), which are per-app, unshared and ungated.

skills.description: How to read, write and list workspace secrets from an agent — including what the human sees when a read is requested, which scope to ask for, and why a read can time out.

default_scope.title: Default approval scope
default_scope.description: How long an approved read stays valid when the agent doesn't ask for a specific scope. one_shot delivers the value exactly once; 10min/60min let the SAME calling process re-read without prompting again.

poll_timeout_s.title: Approval timeout (seconds)
poll_timeout_s.description: How long to wait for the human before giving up. aw-backend expires a pending request at 300s, so a longer value here only delays the same answer.
